name: Chamaemilla
source:
A weary detective. A friend trapped in a sleep she didn't choose. And a teahouse that smells of chamomile. Sit down, have a cup, and decide how long you're willing to stay.

[From [url=https://pollygon.itch.io/chamaemilla]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个疲惫的侦探。一位朋友陷入了她不选择的睡眠中。还有一间充满洋甘菊香味的茶馆。坐下来，喝一杯，然后决定你愿意待多久。

[来自[url=https://pollygon.itch.io/chamaemilla]itch.io[/url]]
